Single continuous first-person eye-camera approach through the already parted daytime tent entrance toward the same Gou An resting on his rope bed, preserving the supplied face, clothes, pose and daylight. Only soft canvas curtain edges may pass the foreground. He stays resting throughout, no getting up or moving bedding. No new paper, object or other person. End on his quiet closed-mouth attention. No player face, body, reflection or over-the-shoulder view. No captions, writing, titles, labels, cards, lists, tables, screen text, blur patches, masks, mosaic or overlays.

SPOKEN DIALOGUE WHITELIST IS EMPTY. No dialogue, no narration, no extra human voice, no muttering or reading. Any visible man listens with lips gently closed. Quiet breathing or a natural blink is allowed, but no sustained speaking mouth shapes. No BGM, no background music, no score, no singing or musical rhythm. Only soft location ambience and action-synchronous natural sound.
